mapper.select: SELECT word_id, english, chinese, part_of_speech, source, owner_id FROM words WHERE source = 'builtin'
SELECT word_id, english, chinese, part_of_speech, source, owner_id FROM words WHERE word_id = #{wordId} AND (source = 'builtin' OR (source = 'custom' AND owner_id = #{userId}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO words (english, chinese, part_of_speech, source, owner_id) VALUES (#{english}, #{chinese}, #{partOfSpeech}, #{source}, #{ownerId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM words WHERE word_id = #{wordId} AND source = 'custom' AND owner_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.select: SELECT w.word_id, w.english, w.chinese, w.part_of_speech, COALESCE(p.proficiency, 0) AS proficiency FROM words w LEFT JOIN user_word_progress p ON p.word_id = w.word_id AND p.user_id = #{userId} WHERE w.source = 'builtin'
